stories.headline: Binance resumes withdrawals after $6.3B heist
stories.summary: Binance resumed withdrawals in phases after covering 95% of $6.3 billion in stolen tokens. The FBI attributes the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit; Pyongyang denies state-linked cyber theft.

stories.headline: OpenAI tightens teen weapons safeguards
stories.summary: OpenAI says it will restrict practical weapons information for teens and may pause accounts repeatedly fixated on violence. The safeguards begin rolling out in coming weeks; outside testing has found gaps in other teen protections.

stories.headline: Trump campaigns as midterms near
stories.summary: Trump is rallying in Iowa and Kansas two days before elections deciding Congress. More than 52 million votes are already cast; close races and election-related court fights leave control uncertain.

stories.headline: US-Iran mediation continues in Qatar
stories.summary: Iranian envoys met Qatari mediators on paths out of the Gulf war. Rubio says Trump has not decided on new strikes and prefers diplomacy, while Iran ordered military readiness; major negotiating gaps remain.

stories.headline: COP17 speeds biodiversity action, lacks funds
stories.summary: Governments adopted the Yerevan Pathway to accelerate biodiversity work through 2030, but the UN says the world remains off track on nearly all targets and the financing needed to deliver them is unresolved.
